pretexts: caller claims to be from CAFC or working with CAFC
fraud investigator from bank or credit card provider
can recover funds from previous fraud
represent law enforcement or government agency
located victim's money or conducting investigation

kill_chain_signals.contact: Fraudsters may contact victims by phone, email or social media claiming to be from the CAFC
kill_chain_signals.pretext: They may claim they are working with the CAFC and tell you there are unauthorized transactions on your account
kill_chain_signals.payment: They may ask you to transfer money to a safe account, send money to assist with an investigation, or pay administrative fees, taxes or legal costs

red_flags: asked to transfer money or make a payment
asked for remote access to computer or device
asked for banking information, passwords or verification codes
asked to pay money to recover money already lost
key_quote: The CAFC and police will never ask you to transfer money or make a payment.
title: Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre Impersonation
